sections.content: How many people are "charitable organisation managers and directors"?

18,770 people

were counted on the census as "charitable organisation managers and directors" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Charitable organisation managers and directors co-ordinate and direct the activities of organisations in the charitable and not-for-profit sector.

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 40 to 44 years. Of the whole working population 10.9% were aged 40 to 44 years. For people working as "charitable organisation managers and directors", 14.6% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "charitable organisation managers and directors" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "charitable organisation managers and directors" included:

  • travel agency managers and proprietors
  • production managers and directors in mining and energy
  • managers and proprietors in other services (other)

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "charitable organisation managers and directors" there were more women than men (63.3% compared with 36.7%).

This means "charitable organisation managers and directors" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "corporate managers and directors".

Men made up 36.7% and women made up 63.3% of "charitable organisation managers and directors"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "charitable organisation managers and directors" included:

  • project support officers
  • pharmacists
  • call and contact centre occupations

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "charitable organisation managers and directors", 11.5% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (75.5% compared with 24.5%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (90.2%) than self-employed (9.8%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was London. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Lambeth, this is in the same region of London.
